core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rafaat corresponds to the Arabic form رِفْعَة (Arabic root ر ف ع (r-f-ʿ); رِفْعَة (Rifʿa)). Its core sense is rafaat; elevation, dignity. persian.name: رفعت
